features: 8 fl oz brewing capacity, identified by the manufacturer as one cup.
Press packs into the included mug; the mug has a red silicone lid.
Manual immersion and pressure brewing with compatible micro-filters.
benefits: A compact option for a coffee routine without a permanent electric brewer.
The mug doubles as storage for the press between uses.
considerations: Requires ground coffee, compatible filters and a separate source of hot water.
One-cup capacity suits a single serving rather than a large batch.
Espresso-style recipes do not make this a pump-driven espresso machine; confirm current kit contents on Amazon.
